web.title: Hours of work - Fair Work Ombudsman
web.description:
# Hours of work
## Maximum weekly hours
Under the [National Employment StandardsThe minimum entitlements that have to be provided to all employees.](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/taxonomy/term/402) (NES), an employee can work a maximum of 38 hours in a week unless an employer asks them to work reasonable extra hours.

For more information on maximum weekly hours under the NES and when additional hours are reasonable, visit our [Maximum weekly hours fact sheet](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/how-we-will-help/templates-and-guides/fact-sheets/minimum-workplace-entitlements/maximum-weekly-hours).
